Whisper Table

Roll d10

Roll Whisper
1 “It doesn’t matter if she’s been acting strangely. She’s the princess.”
2 “OK, lesson learned. Do NOT compare Lady Stella to her sisters.”
3 “There’s not enough silver in the world to get me to go near those stones again. I’m here to fight dragons, not ghosts.”
4 “I don’t get Sir Raphael at all. What kind of knight brings his lute to slay a dragon?”
5 “I’ll be honest. I’m more scared of Sir Damon than the dragon.”
6 “I’ve got nothing against magic, but that hooded guy who follows around Sir Damon gives me the creeps.”
7 “I’ve heard gnomish ale is to die for. They’re supposed to live in the forest somewhere, you know!”
8 “Remember, don’t take any of the dragon’s treasure. That’s how you end up cursed!”
9 “I REALLY hope we don’t run into the field of yellow flowers again. My sides still hurt from laughing.
10 “Yeah, the pool is supposed to be enchanted? That’s what I’ve heard anyway.”
